chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Awwad, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I saw him: when he raised his head from the second sajdah of the first rak'ah, he sat until he became settled, then he stood.

key_terms.الثَّانِيَةِ: the second of two prostrations in the rak'ah

ai.seo_question: Should one sit briefly after the second sajdah before standing for the next rak'ah in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of sitting briefly after the second sajdah of the first rak'ah before standing for the next rak'ah. It indicates a measured and composed manner in salat, which is relevant to the rulings and etiquette of prayer.
